repair_result.repair_prompt:
你是一个 Vue 到 San 迁移修复专家。请根据 SSM、当前 San 代码和校验报告，修复 San 单文件组件。
修复目标：输出必须满足下面列出的 San 结构、语法和渲染一致性规则；不要只生成语义上看起来像 San 的代码。

输出要求：
1. 只输出完整 .san 文件内容，不要输出解释、标题或 Markdown 代码围栏。
2. 必须包含 <template>、<script>、<style> 三段。
3. <script> 中必须使用 const san = require('san')、const DataTypes = san.DataTypes、module.exports = san.defineComponent(...)。
4. Vue props 必须迁移为 San dataTypes，禁止在 san.defineComponent 中输出 props: {...}。
5. initData() 只能返回稳定默认数据对象；Vue props 的 default（包括数组/对象工厂默认值）必须作为同名字段落入 initData；Vue data() 的全部初始值必须精确等价地保留，包括嵌套对象、数组、数字和启用项集合，不得用空字符串、空数组或删减后的集合替代；如果内部 data 依赖 props，必须在 inited() 中用 this.data.get('propName') 读取并 this.data.set(...) 同步。
6. 组件状态读写必须使用 this.data.get('field') 和 this.data.set('field', value)；San computed 的结果也在 data store 中，computed 之间的依赖以及普通方法读取 computed 时必须使用 this.data.get('computedName')，禁止 this.computed.foo()；Vue 的 this.$emit(...) 或 emitEvent 包装方法必须迁移为 this.fire(...)，禁止 this.props、this.xxx 状态读写、this.$emit 和用 this.dispatch(...) 代替自定义事件。
7. 方法必须直接定义在 san.defineComponent 顶层，禁止保留 Vue 的 methods: {...} 包裹。

<template>
<section class="support-ticket-console">
  <header>
    <div>
      <p class="muted">{{openCount}} 个处理中</p>
      <h2>{{inboxTitle}}</h2>
    </div>
    <div class="actions">
      <input placeholder="搜索" value="{= query =}" on-input="updateQuery" />
      <select value="{= statusFilter =}" on-change="updateStatusFilter">
        <option value="all">全部状态</option>
        <option value="open">处理中</option>
        <option value="pending">等待客户</option>
        <option value="closed">已关闭</option>
      </select>
    </div>
  </header>
  <div class="tag-strip">
    <button s-for="tag in allTags trackby tag" class="{{tag === selectedTag ? 'active' : ''}}" on-click="filterTag(tag)">{{tag}}</button>
  </div>
  <div class="ticket-layout">
    <aside class="ticket-list">
      <button s-for="ticket in visibleTickets trackby ticket.id" class="{{'selected: ' + (ticket.id === selectedId) + '; urgent: ' + (ticket.priority === 'urgent')}}" on-click="selectTicket(ticket.id)">
        <span>
          <strong>#{{ticket.id}} {{ticket.subject}}</strong>
          <small>{{ticket.customer}} · {{statusText(ticket.status)}}</small>
        </span>
        <i>{{priorityText(ticket.priority)}}</i>
      </button>
      <p class="empty" s-if="!visibleTickets.length">无匹配工单</p>
    </aside>
    <main s-if="selectedTicket">
      <div class="conversation-head">
        <div>
          <h3>{{selectedTicket.subject}}</h3>
          <span>{{selectedTicket.customer}}</span>
        </div>
        <span class="{{'sla ' + slaState}}">SLA {{selectedTicket.age + nowTick}} 分钟</span>
      </div>
      <div class="messages">
        <article s-for="message in selectedTicket.messages trackby message.id" class="{{message.internal ? 'internal' : ''}}">
          <strong>{{message.author}}</strong>
          <p>{{message.text}}</p>
        </article>
      </div>
      <form class="reply-box" on-submit="sendReply">
        <div>
          <button s-for="text in cannedReplies trackby text" on-click="useCanned(text)">{{text}}</button>
        </div>
        <textarea value="{= replyDraft =}" on-input="updateReply"></textarea>
        <footer>
          <label>
            内部备注
            <input type="checkbox" checked="{= internalNote =}" on-change="toggleInternal" />
          </label>
          <button class="primary" type="submit" disabled="{{!replyDraft}}">发送</button>
        </footer>
      </form>
    </main>
    <aside class="ticket-properties" s-if="selectedTicket">
      <h3>工单属性</h3>
      <label>
        负责人
        <select value="{= selectedTicket.assignee =}" on-change="assignAgent">
          <option value="">未分配</option>
          <option s-for="agent in agents trackby agent" value="{= agent =}">{{agent}}</option>
        </select>
      </label>
      <div>
        <b s-for="tag in selectedTicket.tags trackby tag">{{tag}}</b>
      </div>
      <div>
        <button on-click="changeStatus('open')">处理中</button>
        <button on-click="changeStatus('pending')">等待</button>
        <button on-click="changeStatus('closed')">关闭</button>
      </div>
      <label>
        合并到
        <select value="{= mergeTargetId || '' =}" on-change="setMergeTarget">
          <option value="">选择工单</option>
          <option s-for="ticket in mergeCandidates trackby ticket.id" value="{= ticket.id =}">#{{ticket.id}}</option>
        </select>
      </label>
      <button on-click="mergeTicket" disabled="{{!mergeTargetId}}">执行合并</button>
    </aside>
  </div>
</section>
</template>

<script>
const san = require('san');
const DataTypes = san.DataTypes;

module.exports = san.defineComponent({
  name: 'SupportTicketConsole',
  dataTypes: {
    inboxTitle: DataTypes.string,
    agents: DataTypes.array,
    initialTickets: DataTypes.array,
    cannedReplies: DataTypes.array
  },
  initData() {
    return {
      tickets: [],
      selectedId: null,
      query: '',
      statusFilter: 'all',
      replyDraft: '',
      internalNote: false,
      selectedTag: '',
      mergeTargetId: null,
      nowTick: 0,
      timer: null
    };
  },
  computed: {
    visibleTickets() {
      const q = this.data.get('query').toLowerCase();
      const rank = { urgent: 0, high: 1, normal: 2 };
      return this.data.get('tickets').filter(ticket => (this.data.get('statusFilter') === 'all' || ticket.status === this.data.get('statusFilter')) && (!this.data.get('selectedTag') || ticket.tags.indexOf(this.data.get('selectedTag')) >= 0) && (ticket.subject.toLowerCase().indexOf(q) >= 0 || ticket.customer.toLowerCase().indexOf(q) >= 0)).slice().sort((a, b) => (rank[a.priority] || 3) - (rank[b.priority] || 3));
    },
    selectedTicket() {
      return this.data.get('tickets').find(ticket => ticket.id === this.data.get('selectedId')) || null;
    },
    openCount() {
      return this.data.get('tickets').filter(ticket => ticket.status === 'open').length;
    },
    slaState() {
      const ticket = this.data.get('selectedTicket');
      if (!ticket) return 'none';
      const age = ticket.age + this.data.get('nowTick');
      return age >= 60 ? 'breached' : age >= 45 ? 'warning' : 'safe';
    },
    allTags() {
      return Array.from(new Set(this.data.get('tickets').reduce((all, ticket) => all.concat(ticket.tags), [])));
    },
    mergeCandidates() {
      return this.data.get('tickets').filter(ticket => ticket.id !== this.data.get('selectedId') && ticket.status !== 'closed');
    }
  },
  inited() {
    const initialTickets = this.data.get('initialTickets') || [];
    const tickets = initialTickets.map(ticket => Object.assign({}, ticket, { tags: ticket.tags.slice(), messages: ticket.messages.map(message => Object.assign({}, message)) }));
    this.data.set('tickets', tickets);
    this.data.set('selectedId', initialTickets[0] ? initialTickets[0].id : null);
  },
  attached() {
    this._timer = setInterval(() => {
      this.data.set('nowTick', this.data.get('nowTick') + 1);
    }, 60000);
  },
  disposed() {
    if (this._timer) {
      clearInterval(this._timer);
      this._timer = null;
    }
  },
  setValue(key, value) {
    this.data.set(key, value);
  },
  emitEvent(name, payload) {
    this.fire(name, payload);
  },
  updateQuery(event) {
    this.setValue('query', event.target.value);
  },
  updateStatusFilter(event) {
    this.setValue('statusFilter', event.target.value);
  },
  filterTag(tag) {
    this.setValue('selectedTag', this.data.get('selectedTag') === tag ? '' : tag);
  },
  selectTicket(id) {
    this.setValue('selectedId', id);
    this.setValue('replyDraft', '');
    this.setValue('mergeTargetId', null);
  },
  updateReply(event) {
    this.setValue('replyDraft', event.target.value);
  },
  toggleInternal(event) {
    this.setValue('internalNote', event.target.checked);
  },
  useCanned(text) {
    this.setValue('replyDraft', text);
  },
  sendReply(event) {
    event.preventDefault();
    const text = this.data.get('replyDraft').trim();
    const id = this.data.get('selectedId');
    if (!text || id === null) return;
    const message = {
      id: Date.now(),
      author: this.data.get('internalNote') ? '内部备注' : '客服',
      text,
      internal: this.data.get('internalNote')
    };
    this.setValue('tickets', this.data.get('tickets').map(ticket => ticket.id === id ? Object.assign({}, ticket, { messages: ticket.messages.concat(message), status: this.data.get('internalNote') ? ticket.status : 'pending' }) : ticket));
    this.setValue('replyDraft', '');
    this.emitEvent('reply', { ticketId: id, message });
  },
  changeStatus(status) {
    const id = this.data.get('selectedId');
    this.setValue('tickets', this.data.get('tickets').map(ticket => ticket.id === id ? Object.assign({}, ticket, { status }) : ticket));
    this.emitEvent('status', { ticketId: id, status });
  },
  assignAgent(event) {
    const assignee = event.target.value;
    const id = this.data.get('selectedId');
    this.setValue('tickets', this.data.get('tickets').map(ticket => ticket.id === id ? Object.assign({}, ticket, { assignee }) : ticket));
    this.emitEvent('assign', { ticketId: id, assignee });
  },
  setMergeTarget(event) {
    this.setValue('mergeTargetId', Number(event.target.value) || null);
  },
  mergeTicket() {
    const sourceId = this.data.get('selectedId');
    const targetId = this.data.get('mergeTargetId');
    if (!targetId) return;
    const source = this.data.get('tickets').find(ticket => ticket.id === sourceId);
    this.setValue('tickets', this.data.get('tickets').map(ticket => ticket.id === targetId ? Object.assign({}, ticket, { messages: ticket.messages.concat(source.messages) }) : ticket).filter(ticket => ticket.id !== sourceId));
    this.setValue('selectedId', targetId);
    this.emitEvent('merge', { sourceId, targetId });
  },
  priorityRank(priority) {
    return { urgent: 0, high: 1, normal: 2 }[priority] || 3;
  },
  priorityText(priority) {
    return { urgent: '紧急', high: '高', normal: '普通' }[priority];
  },
  statusText(status) {
    return { open: '处理中', pending: '等待客户', closed: '已关闭' }[status];
  }
});
</script>

<template>
<section class="support-ticket-console">
  <header>
    <div>
      <p class="muted">{{openCount}} 个处理中</p>
      <h2>{{inboxTitle}}</h2>
    </div>
    <div class="actions">
      <input placeholder="搜索" value="{{query}}" on-input="updateQuery" />
      <select value="{{statusFilter}}" on-change="updateStatusFilter">
        <option value="all">全部状态</option>
        <option value="open">处理中</option>
        <option value="pending">等待客户</option>
        <option value="closed">已关闭</option>
      </select>
    </div>
  </header>
  <div class="tag-strip">
    <button s-for="tag in allTags trackby tag" class="{{tag === selectedTag ? 'active' : ''}}" on-click="filterTag(tag)">{{tag}}</button>
  </div>
  <div class="ticket-layout">
    <aside class="ticket-list">
      <button s-for="ticket in visibleTickets trackby ticket.id" class="{{(ticket.id === selectedId) ? 'selected' : ''}} {{ticket.priority === 'urgent' ? 'urgent' : ''}}" on-click="selectTicket(ticket.id)">
        <span>
          <strong>#{{ticket.id}} {{ticket.subject}}</strong>
          <small>{{ticket.customer}} · {{statusText(ticket.status)}}</small>
        </span>
        <i>{{priorityText(ticket.priority)}}</i>
      </button>
      <p class="empty" s-if="!visibleTickets.length">无匹配工单</p>
    </aside>
    <main s-if="selectedTicket">
      <div class="conversation-head">
        <div>
          <h3>{{selectedTicket.subject}}</h3>
          <span>{{selectedTicket.customer}}</span>
        </div>
        <span class="sla {{slaState}}">SLA {{selectedTicket.age + nowTick}} 分钟</span>
      </div>
      <div class="messages">
        <article s-for="message in selectedTicket.messages trackby message.id" class="{{message.internal ? 'internal' : ''}}">
          <strong>{{message.author}}</strong>
          <p>{{message.text}}</p>
        </article>
      </div>
      <form class="reply-box" on-submit="sendReply">
        <div>
          <button s-for="text in cannedReplies trackby text" on-click="useCanned(text)">{{text}}</button>
        </div>
        <textarea value="{{replyDraft}}" on-input="updateReply"></textarea>
        <footer>
          <label>
            内部备注
            <input type="checkbox" checked="{{internalNote}}" on-change="toggleInternal" />
          </label>
          <button class="primary" type="submit" disabled="{{!replyDraft}}">发送</button>
        </footer>
      </form>
    </main>
    <aside class="ticket-properties" s-if="selectedTicket">
      <h3>工单属性</h3>
      <label>
        负责人
        <select value="{{selectedTicket.assignee}}" on-change="assignAgent">
          <option value="">未分配</option>
          <option s-for="agent in agents trackby agent" value="{{agent}}">{{agent}}</option>
        </select>
      </label>
      <div>
        <b s-for="tag in selectedTicket.tags trackby tag">{{tag}}</b>
      </div>
      <div>
        <button on-click="changeStatus('open')">处理中</button>
        <button on-click="changeStatus('pending')">等待</button>
        <button on-click="changeStatus('closed')">关闭</button>
      </div>
      <label>
        合并到
        <select value="{{mergeTargetId || ''}}" on-change="setMergeTarget">
          <option value="">选择工单</option>
          <option s-for="ticket in mergeCandidates trackby ticket.id" value="{{ticket.id}}">#{{ticket.id}}</option>
        </select>
      </label>
      <button on-click="mergeTicket" disabled="{{!mergeTargetId}}">执行合并</button>
    </aside>
  </div>
</section>
</template>

<script>
const san = require('san');
const DataTypes = san.DataTypes;

module.exports = san.defineComponent({
  name: 'SupportTicketConsole',
  dataTypes: {
    inboxTitle: DataTypes.string,
    agents: DataTypes.array,
    initialTickets: DataTypes.array,
    cannedReplies: DataTypes.array
  },
  initData() {
    return {
      tickets: [],
      selectedId: null,
      query: '',
      statusFilter: 'all',
      replyDraft: '',
      internalNote: false,
      selectedTag: '',
      mergeTargetId: null,
      nowTick: 0,
      timer: null,
      inboxTitle: '客户支持收件箱',
      agents: ['林晓', '周宁', '陈雨'],
      initialTickets: [
        {
          "id": 101,
          "subject": "无法完成付款",
          "customer": "安然",
          "priority": "urgent",
          "status": "open",
          "assignee": "林晓",
          "tags": ["支付"],
          "age": 18,
          "messages": [
            {
              "id": 1,
              "author": "客户",
              "text": "付款页面一直提示失败。",
              "internal": false
            }
          ]
        },
        {
          "id": 102,
          "subject": "申请导出数据",
          "customer": "北辰",
          "priority": "normal",
          "status": "pending",
          "assignee": "周宁",
          "tags": ["数据"],
          "age": 55,
          "messages": [
            {
              "id": 2,
              "author": "客户",
              "text": "请问如何导出历史数据？",
              "internal": false
            }
          ]
        },
        {
          "id": 103,
          "subject": "账号权限异常",
          "customer": "知夏",
          "priority": "high",
          "status": "open",
          "assignee": "",
          "tags": ["权限"],
          "age": 32,
          "messages": [
            {
              "id": 3,
              "author": "客户",
              "text": "管理员菜单突然消失。",
              "internal": false
            }
          ]
        }
      ],
      cannedReplies: ["已收到，我们正在处理。", "问题已修复，请刷新后重试。"]
    };
  },
  computed: {
    visibleTickets() {
      const q = this.data.get('query').toLowerCase();
      const rank = { urgent: 0, high: 1, normal: 2 };
      return this.data.get('tickets').filter(ticket => (this.data.get('statusFilter') === 'all' || ticket.status === this.data.get('statusFilter')) && (!this.data.get('selectedTag') || ticket.tags.indexOf(this.data.get('selectedTag')) >= 0) && (ticket.subject.toLowerCase().indexOf(q) >= 0 || ticket.customer.toLowerCase().indexOf(q) >= 0)).slice().sort((a, b) => (rank[a.priority] || 3) - (rank[b.priority] || 3));
    },
    selectedTicket() {
      return this.data.get('tickets').find(ticket => ticket.id === this.data.get('selectedId')) || null;
    },
    openCount() {
      return this.data.get('tickets').filter(ticket => ticket.status === 'open').length;
    },
    slaState() {
      const ticket = this.data.get('selectedTicket');
      if (!ticket) return 'none';
      const age = ticket.age + this.data.get('nowTick');
      return age >= 60 ? 'breached' : age >= 45 ? 'warning' : 'safe';
    },
    allTags() {
      return Array.from(new Set(this.data.get('tickets').reduce((all, ticket) => all.concat(ticket.tags), [])));
    },
    mergeCandidates() {
      return this.data.get('tickets').filter(ticket => ticket.id !== this.data.get('selectedId') && ticket.status !== 'closed');
    }
  },
  inited() {
    const initialTickets = this.data.get('initialTickets') || [];
    const tickets = initialTickets.map(ticket => Object.assign({}, ticket, { tags: ticket.tags.slice(), messages: ticket.messages.map(message => Object.assign({}, message)) }));
    this.data.set('tickets', tickets);
    this.data.set('selectedId', initialTickets[0] ? initialTickets[0].id : null);
  },
  attached() {
    this._timer = setInterval(() => {
      this.data.set('nowTick', this.data.get('nowTick') + 1);
    }, 60000);
  },
  disposed() {
    if (this._timer) {
      clearInterval(this._timer);
      this._timer = null;
    }
  },
  setValue(key, value) {
    this.data.set(key, value);
  },
  emitEvent(name, payload) {
    this.fire(name, payload);
  },
  updateQuery(event) {
    this.setValue('query', event.target.value);
  },
  updateStatusFilter(event) {
    this.setValue('statusFilter', event.target.value);
  },
  filterTag(tag) {
    this.setValue('selectedTag', this.data.get('selectedTag') === tag ? '' : tag);
  },
  selectTicket(id) {
    this.setValue('selectedId', id);
    this.setValue('replyDraft', '');
    this.setValue('mergeTargetId', null);
  },
  updateReply(event) {
    this.setValue('replyDraft', event.target.value);
  },
  toggleInternal(event) {
    this.setValue('internalNote', event.target.checked);
  },
  useCanned(text) {
    this.setValue('replyDraft', text);
  },
  sendReply(event) {
    event.preventDefault();
    const text = this.data.get('replyDraft').trim();
    const id = this.data.get('selectedId');
    if (!text || id === null) return;
    const message = {
      id: Date.now(),
      author: this.data.get('internalNote') ? '内部备注' : '客服',
      text,
      internal: this.data.get('internalNote')
    };
    this.setValue('tickets', this.data.get('tickets').map(ticket => ticket.id === id ? Object.assign({}, ticket, { messages: ticket.messages.concat(message), status: this.data.get('internalNote') ? ticket.status : 'pending' }) : ticket));
    this.setValue('replyDraft', '');
    this.emitEvent('reply', { ticketId: id, message });
  },
  changeStatus(status) {
    const id = this.data.get('selectedId');
    this.setValue('tickets', this.data.get('tickets').map(ticket => ticket.id === id ? Object.assign({}, ticket, { status }) : ticket));
    this.emitEvent('status', { ticketId: id, status });
  },
  assignAgent(event) {
    const assignee = event.target.value;
    const id = this.data.get('selectedId');
    this.setValue('tickets', this.data.get('tickets').map(ticket => ticket.id === id ? Object.assign({}, ticket, { assignee }) : ticket));
    this.emitEvent('assign', { ticketId: id, assignee });
  },
  setMergeTarget(event) {
    this.setValue('mergeTargetId', Number(event.target.value) || null);
  },
  mergeTicket() {
    const sourceId = this.data.get('selectedId');
    const targetId = this.data.get('mergeTargetId');
    if (!targetId) return;
    const source = this.data.get('tickets').find(ticket => ticket.id === sourceId);
    this.setValue('tickets', this.data.get('tickets').map(ticket => ticket.id === targetId ? Object.assign({}, ticket, { messages: ticket.messages.concat(source.messages) }) : ticket).filter(ticket => ticket.id !== sourceId));
    this.setValue('selectedId', targetId);
    this.emitEvent('merge', { sourceId, targetId });
  },
  priorityRank(priority) {
    return { urgent: 0, high: 1, normal: 2 }[priority] || 3;
  },
  priorityText(priority) {
    return { urgent: '紧急', high: '高', normal: '普通' }[priority];
  },
  statusText(status) {
    return { open: '处理中', pending: '等待客户', closed: '已关闭' }[status];
  }
});
</script>

<template>
<section class="support-ticket-console">
  <header>
    <div>
      <p class="muted">{{openCount}} 个处理中</p>
      <h2>{{inboxTitle}}</h2>
    </div>
    <div class="actions">
      <input placeholder="搜索" value="{{query}}" on-input="updateQuery" />
      <select value="{{statusFilter}}" on-change="updateStatusFilter">
        <option value="all">全部状态</option>
        <option value="open">处理中</option>
        <option value="pending">等待客户</option>
        <option value="closed">已关闭</option>
      </select>
    </div>
  </header>
  <div class="tag-strip">
    <button s-for="tag in allTags trackby tag" class="{{tag === selectedTag ? 'active' : ''}}" on-click="filterTag(tag)">{{tag}}</button>
  </div>
  <div class="ticket-layout">
    <aside class="ticket-list">
      <button s-for="ticket in visibleTickets trackby ticket.id" class="{{selectedId === ticket.id ? 'selected' : ''}} {{ticket.priority === 'urgent' ? 'urgent' : ''}}" on-click="selectTicket(ticket.id)">
        <span>
          <strong>#{{ticket.id}} {{ticket.subject}}</strong>
          <small>{{ticket.customer}} · {{statusText(ticket.status)}}</small>
        </span>
        <i>{{priorityText(ticket.priority)}}</i>
      </button>
      <p class="empty" s-if="{{!visibleTickets.length}}">无匹配工单</p>
    </aside>
    <main s-if="{{selectedTicket}}">
      <div class="conversation-head">
        <div>
          <h3>{{selectedTicket.subject}}</h3>
          <span>{{selectedTicket.customer}}</span>
        </div>
        <span class="sla {{slaState}}">SLA {{selectedTicket.age + nowTick}} 分钟</span>
      </div>
      <div class="messages">
        <article s-for="message in selectedTicket.messages trackby message.id" class="{{message.internal ? 'internal' : ''}}">
          <strong>{{message.author}}</strong>
          <p>{{message.text}}</p>
        </article>
      </div>
      <form class="reply-box" on-submit="sendReply">
        <div>
          <button s-for="text in cannedReplies trackby text" on-click="useCanned(text)">{{text}}</button>
        </div>
        <textarea value="{{replyDraft}}" on-input="updateReply"></textarea>
        <footer>
          <label>
            内部备注
            <input type="checkbox" checked="{{internalNote}}" on-change="toggleInternal" />
          </label>
          <button class="primary" type="submit" disabled="{{!replyDraft}}">发送</button>
        </footer>
      </form>
    </main>
    <aside class="ticket-properties" s-if="{{selectedTicket}}">
      <h3>工单属性</h3>
      <label>
        负责人
        <select value="{{selectedTicket.assignee}}" on-change="assignAgent">
          <option value="">未分配</option>
          <option s-for="agent in agents trackby agent" value="{{agent}}">{{agent}}</option>
        </select>
      </label>
      <div>
        <b s-for="tag in selectedTicket.tags trackby tag">{{tag}}</b>
      </div>
      <div>
        <button on-click="changeStatus('open')">处理中</button>
        <button on-click="changeStatus('pending')">等待</button>
        <button on-click="changeStatus('closed')">关闭</button>
      </div>
      <label>
        合并到
        <select value="{{mergeTargetId || ''}}" on-change="setMergeTarget">
          <option value="">选择工单</option>
          <option s-for="ticket in mergeCandidates trackby ticket.id" value="{{ticket.id}}">#{{ticket.id}}</option>
        </select>
      </label>
      <button on-click="mergeTicket" disabled="{{!mergeTargetId}}">执行合并</button>
    </aside>
  </div>
</section>
</template>

<script>
const san = require('san');
const DataTypes = san.DataTypes;

module.exports = san.defineComponent({
  name: 'SupportTicketConsole',
  dataTypes: {
    inboxTitle: DataTypes.string,
    agents: DataTypes.array,
    initialTickets: DataTypes.array,
    cannedReplies: DataTypes.array
  },
  initData() {
    return {
      tickets: [],
      selectedId: null,
      query: '',
      statusFilter: 'all',
      replyDraft: '',
      internalNote: false,
      selectedTag: '',
      mergeTargetId: null,
      nowTick: 0,
      timer: null
    };
  },
  computed: {
    visibleTickets() {
      const q = this.data.get('query').toLowerCase();
      const rank = { urgent: 0, high: 1, normal: 2 };
      return this.data.get('tickets').filter(ticket => (this.data.get('statusFilter') === 'all' || ticket.status === this.data.get('statusFilter')) && (!this.data.get('selectedTag') || ticket.tags.indexOf(this.data.get('selectedTag')) >= 0) && (ticket.subject.toLowerCase().indexOf(q) >= 0 || ticket.customer.toLowerCase().indexOf(q) >= 0)).slice().sort((a, b) => (rank[a.priority] || 3) - (rank[b.priority] || 3));
    },
    selectedTicket() {
      return this.data.get('tickets').find(ticket => ticket.id === this.data.get('selectedId')) || null;
    },
    openCount() {
      return this.data.get('tickets').filter(ticket => ticket.status === 'open').length;
    },
    slaState() {
      const ticket = this.data.get('selectedTicket');
      if (!ticket) return 'none';
      const age = ticket.age + this.data.get('nowTick');
      return age >= 60 ? 'breached' : age >= 45 ? 'warning' : 'safe';
    },
    allTags() {
      return Array.from(new Set(this.data.get('tickets').reduce((all, ticket) => all.concat(ticket.tags), [])));
    },
    mergeCandidates() {
      return this.data.get('tickets').filter(ticket => ticket.id !== this.data.get('selectedId') && ticket.status !== 'closed');
    }
  },
  inited() {
    const initialTickets = this.data.get('initialTickets') || [];
    const tickets = initialTickets.map(ticket => Object.assign({}, ticket, { tags: ticket.tags.slice(), messages: ticket.messages.map(message => Object.assign({}, message)) }));
    this.data.set('tickets', tickets);
    this.data.set('selectedId', initialTickets[0] ? initialTickets[0].id : null);
  },
  attached() {
    this._timer = setInterval(() => {
      this.data.set('nowTick', this.data.get('nowTick') + 1);
    }, 60000);
  },
  disposed() {
    if (this._timer) {
      clearInterval(this._timer);
      this._timer = null;
    }
  },
  setValue(key, value) {
    this.data.set(key, value);
  },
  emitEvent(name, payload) {
    this.fire(name, payload);
  },
  updateQuery(event) {
    this.data.set('query', event.target.value);
  },
  updateStatusFilter(event) {
    this.data.set('statusFilter', event.target.value);
  },
  filterTag(tag) {
    this.data.set('selectedTag', this.data.get('selectedTag') === tag ? '' : tag);
  },
  selectTicket(id) {
    this.data.set('selectedId', id);
    this.data.set('replyDraft', '');
    this.data.set('mergeTargetId', null);
  },
  updateReply(event) {
    this.data.set('replyDraft', event.target.value);
  },
  toggleInternal(event) {
    this.data.set('internalNote', event.target.checked);
  },
  useCanned(text) {
    this.data.set('replyDraft', text);
  },
  sendReply(event) {
    event.preventDefault();
    const text = this.data.get('replyDraft').trim();
    const id = this.data.get('selectedId');
    if (!text || id === null) return;
    const message = {
      id: Date.now(),
      author: this.data.get('internalNote') ? '内部备注' : '客服',
      text,
      internal: this.data.get('internalNote')
    };
    this.data.set('tickets', this.data.get('tickets').map(ticket => ticket.id === id ? Object.assign({}, ticket, { messages: ticket.messages.concat(message), status: this.data.get('internalNote') ? ticket.status : 'pending' }) : ticket));
    this.data.set('replyDraft', '');
    this.emitEvent('reply', { ticketId: id, message });
  },
  changeStatus(status) {
    const id = this.data.get('selectedId');
    this.data.set('tickets', this.data.get('tickets').map(ticket => ticket.id === id ? Object.assign({}, ticket, { status }) : ticket));
    this.emitEvent('status', { ticketId: id, status });
  },
  assignAgent(event) {
    const assignee = event.target.value;
    const id = this.data.get('selectedId');
    this.data.set('tickets', this.data.get('tickets').map(ticket => ticket.id === id ? Object.assign({}, ticket, { assignee }) : ticket));
    this.emitEvent('assign', { ticketId: id, assignee });
  },
  setMergeTarget(event) {
    this.data.set('mergeTargetId', Number(event.target.value) || null);
  },
  mergeTicket() {
    const sourceId = this.data.get('selectedId');
    const targetId = this.data.get('mergeTargetId');
    if (!targetId) return;
    const source = this.data.get('tickets').find(ticket => ticket.id === sourceId);
    this.data.set('tickets', this.data.get('tickets').map(ticket => ticket.id === targetId ? Object.assign({}, ticket, { messages: ticket.messages.concat(source.messages) }) : ticket).filter(ticket => ticket.id !== sourceId));
    this.data.set('selectedId', targetId);
    this.emitEvent('merge', { sourceId, targetId });
  },
  priorityRank(priority) {
    return { urgent: 0, high: 1, normal: 2 }[priority] || 3;
  },
  priorityText(priority) {
    return { urgent: '紧急', high: '高', normal: '普通' }[priority];
  },
  statusText(status) {
    return { open: '处理中', pending: '等待客户', closed: '已关闭' }[status];
  }
});
</script>

san_generation_contract.description: 约束大模型基于本 schema 生成 San 组件时必须满足的条件。
must_preserve: metadata.component_name 和根节点语义
template.dom_tree 的层级结构、节点顺序与语义角色
template.component_refs 中每个子组件的注册名和父子通信事件
binding_graph 中 data/props/computed 到模板节点的可见绑定
event_model 中每个 DOM 事件和自定义事件的触发时机与 payload
style_model 中动态类名、动态样式、scoped CSS 和关键视觉状态
script.options.lifecycle_hooks 中的副作用初始化与清理逻辑
script.options.data 中所有字段的默认值和外部初始化来源
quality_checks: template.component_refs 中每个子组件都在 script.components 或 san_registration 中有定义
binding_graph.edges 中每条 template 依赖都能在 script.options 中找到来源
event_model.dom_events 中每个 handler_name 都存在于 script.options.methods
event_model.custom_events 中每个 emit_points 都对应 method 中的 $emit 调用
style_model.dynamic_class_bindings 的 dependencies 都存在于 binding_graph.nodes
script.options.watch 中的 deep watcher 在 migration_hints 中被标记并给出替代策略
san_syntax_requirements: 输出完整的 .san 单文件组件，包含 <template>、<script>、<style> 三个代码块；若无样式也保留空 style 或显式说明无样式
脚本块显式引入 san：const san = require('san')，并使用 module.exports = san.defineComponent(...) 导出组件
props 使用 san.DataTypes 声明，与 script.options.props 一一对应；优先输出 DataTypes.number / string / bool / array / object
组件定义使用 san.defineComponent
组件名来自 metadata.component_name，并显式输出 name 字段
data 使用 initData 返回默认值，与 script.options.data 一一对应；不要在 initData 中直接依赖复杂运行时读取
当 data 字段来源于 props 或外部初始化时，优先在 inited/attached 中用 this.data.set 完成同步
模板中使用 s-if、s-for、on-event、value={= =}、checked={= =} 等 San 语法
状态访问统一使用 this.data.get() / this.data.set()
优先将 methods 直接定义在组件对象顶层，避免保留 Vue 风格的 methods: {} 包裹
子组件标签使用短横线命名
子组件在 components 中显式注册
样式块需尽量完整输出，优先复用 styles/style_model 中已有 class 与 css_rules 信息
定时器、timeout、外部监听等副作用在 attached/disposed 中管理

你是一个 Vue 到 San 迁移修复专家。请根据 SSM、当前 San 代码和校验报告，修复 San 单文件组件。
修复目标：输出必须满足下面列出的 San 结构、语法和渲染一致性规则；不要只生成语义上看起来像 San 的代码。

输出要求：
1. 只输出完整 .san 文件内容，不要输出解释、标题或 Markdown 代码围栏。
2. 必须包含 <template>、<script>、<style> 三段。
3. <script> 中必须使用 const san = require('san')、const DataTypes = san.DataTypes、module.exports = san.defineComponent(...)。
4. Vue props 必须迁移为 San dataTypes，禁止在 san.defineComponent 中输出 props: {...}。
5. initData() 只能返回稳定默认数据对象；Vue props 的 default（包括数组/对象工厂默认值）必须作为同名字段落入 initData；Vue data() 的全部初始值必须精确等价地保留，包括嵌套对象、数组、数字和启用项集合，不得用空字符串、空数组或删减后的集合替代；如果内部 data 依赖 props，必须在 inited() 中用 this.data.get('propName') 读取并 this.data.set(...) 同步。
6. 组件状态读写必须使用 this.data.get('field') 和 this.data.set('field', value)；San computed 的结果也在 data store 中，computed 之间的依赖以及普通方法读取 computed 时必须使用 this.data.get('computedName')，禁止 this.computed.foo()；Vue 的 this.$emit(...) 或 emitEvent 包装方法必须迁移为 this.fire(...)，禁止 this.props、this.xxx 状态读写、this.$emit 和用 this.dispatch(...) 代替自定义事件。
7. 方法必须直接定义在 san.defineComponent 顶层，禁止保留 Vue 的 methods: {...} 包裹。
8. template 必须使用 San 语法：on-click、s-if、s-for；保留事件调用的全部参数，例如 on-click="move(-1)"、on-click="select(task.id)"；Vue v-for 的 :key 必须写入 s-for 的 trackby 子句，例如 s-for="task in tasks trackby task.id"，禁止输出独立 key="{{ task.id }}" 或 key="{= task.id =}"；所有 {{ ... }} 和 {= ... =} 插值必须完整闭合；双向绑定 {= assignable.path =} 只能用于可赋值的数据路径，方法调用、computed 表达式和其他派生值必须使用单向插值；disabled、checked、selected 等派生属性必须使用 disabled="{{ expression }}" 这一类单向插值，禁止写成 disabled="{= expression =}"；方法调用、computed 表达式和其他派生值必须使用单向插值，例如 checked="{{ isEnabled(rule.id, enabled) }}"；禁止丢失参数、使用 data-args/getAttribute 绕行，或保留 @click、v-if、v-for、v-model、:class 等 Vue 模板语法。
9. style 标签必须写成 <style>，禁止输出 <style scoped>；必须保留原有 class 名和样式内容。
10. 不要重新设计组件，不要引入外部依赖，不要删除已有 DOM 节点、文本、class 或样式。
11. 如果 DOM 对比报告指出缺失/新增/变化节点，优先修复 template 结构。
12. 补充要求：优先修复 validate 与 visual_eval 报告中指出的问题，保持原有 DOM 结构、文本、class 和样式。

<template>
<section class="support-ticket-console">
  <header>
    <div>
      <p class="muted">{{openCount}} 个处理中</p>
      <h2>{{inboxTitle}}</h2>
    </div>
    <div class="actions">
      <input placeholder="搜索" value="{{query}}" on-input="updateQuery" />
      <select value="{{statusFilter}}" on-change="updateStatusFilter">
        <option value="all">全部状态</option>
        <option value="open">处理中</option>
        <option value="pending">等待客户</option>
        <option value="closed">已关闭</option>
      </select>
    </div>
  </header>
  <div class="tag-strip">
    <button s-for="tag in allTags trackby tag" class="{{tag === selectedTag ? 'active' : ''}}" on-click="filterTag(tag)">{{tag}}</button>
  </div>
  <div class="ticket-layout">
    <aside class="ticket-list">
      <button s-for="ticket in visibleTickets trackby ticket.id" class="{{selectedId === ticket.id ? 'selected' : ''}} {{ticket.priority === 'urgent' ? 'urgent' : ''}}" on-click="selectTicket(ticket.id)">
        <span>
          <strong>#{{ticket.id}} {{ticket.subject}}</strong>
          <small>{{ticket.customer}} · {{statusText(ticket.status)}}</small>
        </span>
        <i>{{priorityText(ticket.priority)}}</i>
      </button>
      <p class="empty" s-if="{{!visibleTickets.length}}">无匹配工单</p>
    </aside>
    <main s-if="{{selectedTicket}}">
      <div class="conversation-head">
        <div>
          <h3>{{selectedTicket.subject}}</h3>
          <span>{{selectedTicket.customer}}</span>
        </div>
        <span class="sla {{slaState}}">SLA {{selectedTicket.age + nowTick}} 分钟</span>
      </div>
      <div class="messages">
        <article s-for="message in selectedTicket.messages trackby message.id" class="{{message.internal ? 'internal' : ''}}">
          <strong>{{message.author}}</strong>
          <p>{{message.text}}</p>
        </article>
      </div>
      <form class="reply-box" on-submit="sendReply">
        <div>
          <button s-for="text in cannedReplies trackby text" on-click="useCanned(text)">{{text}}</button>
        </div>
        <textarea value="{{replyDraft}}" on-input="updateReply"></textarea>
        <footer>
          <label>
            内部备注
            <input type="checkbox" checked="{{internalNote}}" on-change="toggleInternal" />
          </label>
          <button class="primary" type="submit" disabled="{{!replyDraft}}">发送</button>
        </footer>
      </form>
    </main>
    <aside class="ticket-properties" s-if="{{selectedTicket}}">
      <h3>工单属性</h3>
      <label>
        负责人
        <select value="{{selectedTicket.assignee}}" on-change="assignAgent">
          <option value="">未分配</option>
          <option s-for="agent in agents trackby agent" value="{{agent}}">{{agent}}</option>
        </select>
      </label>
      <div>
        <b s-for="tag in selectedTicket.tags trackby tag">{{tag}}</b>
      </div>
      <div>
        <button on-click="changeStatus('open')">处理中</button>
        <button on-click="changeStatus('pending')">等待</button>
        <button on-click="changeStatus('closed')">关闭</button>
      </div>
      <label>
        合并到
        <select value="{{mergeTargetId || ''}}" on-change="setMergeTarget">
          <option value="">选择工单</option>
          <option s-for="ticket in mergeCandidates trackby ticket.id" value="{{ticket.id}}">#{{ticket.id}}</option>
        </select>
      </label>
      <button on-click="mergeTicket" disabled="{{!mergeTargetId}}">执行合并</button>
    </aside>
  </div>
</section>
</template>

<script>
const san = require('san');
const DataTypes = san.DataTypes;

module.exports = san.defineComponent({
  name: 'SupportTicketConsole',
  dataTypes: {
    inboxTitle: DataTypes.string,
    agents: DataTypes.array,
    initialTickets: DataTypes.array,
    cannedReplies: DataTypes.array
  },
  initData() {
    return {
      tickets: [],
      selectedId: null,
      query: '',
      statusFilter: 'all',
      replyDraft: '',
      internalNote: false,
      selectedTag: '',
      mergeTargetId: null,
      nowTick: 0,
      timer: null
    };
  },
  computed: {
    visibleTickets() {
      const q = this.data.get('query').toLowerCase();
      const rank = { urgent: 0, high: 1, normal: 2 };
      return this.data.get('tickets').filter(ticket => (this.data.get('statusFilter') === 'all' || ticket.status === this.data.get('statusFilter')) && (!this.data.get('selectedTag') || ticket.tags.indexOf(this.data.get('selectedTag')) >= 0) && (ticket.subject.toLowerCase().indexOf(q) >= 0 || ticket.customer.toLowerCase().indexOf(q) >= 0)).slice().sort((a, b) => (rank[a.priority] || 3) - (rank[b.priority] || 3));
    },
    selectedTicket() {
      return this.data.get('tickets').find(ticket => ticket.id === this.data.get('selectedId')) || null;
    },
    openCount() {
      return this.data.get('tickets').filter(ticket => ticket.status === 'open').length;
    },
    slaState() {
      const ticket = this.data.get('selectedTicket');
      if (!ticket) return 'none';
      const age = ticket.age + this.data.get('nowTick');
      return age >= 60 ? 'breached' : age >= 45 ? 'warning' : 'safe';
    },
    allTags() {
      return Array.from(new Set(this.data.get('tickets').reduce((all, ticket) => all.concat(ticket.tags), [])));
    },
    mergeCandidates() {
      return this.data.get('tickets').filter(ticket => ticket.id !== this.data.get('selectedId') && ticket.status !== 'closed');
    }
  },
  inited() {
    const initialTickets = this.data.get('initialTickets') || [];
    const tickets = initialTickets.map(ticket => Object.assign({}, ticket, { tags: ticket.tags.slice(), messages: ticket.messages.map(message => Object.assign({}, message)) }));
    this.data.set('tickets', tickets);
    this.data.set('selectedId', initialTickets[0] ? initialTickets[0].id : null);
  },
  attached() {
    this._timer = setInterval(() => {
      this.data.set('nowTick', this.data.get('nowTick') + 1);
    }, 60000);
  },
  disposed() {
    if (this._timer) {
      clearInterval(this._timer);
      this._timer = null;
    }
  },
  setValue(key, value) {
    this.data.set(key, value);
  },
  emitEvent(name, payload) {
    this.fire(name, payload);
  },
  updateQuery(event) {
    this.data.set('query', event.target.value);
  },
  updateStatusFilter(event) {
    this.data.set('statusFilter', event.target.value);
  },
  filterTag(tag) {
    this.data.set('selectedTag', this.data.get('selectedTag') === tag ? '' : tag);
  },
  selectTicket(id) {
    this.data.set('selectedId', id);
    this.data.set('replyDraft', '');
    this.data.set('mergeTargetId', null);
  },
  updateReply(event) {
    this.data.set('replyDraft', event.target.value);
  },
  toggleInternal(event) {
    this.data.set('internalNote', event.target.checked);
  },
  useCanned(text) {
    this.data.set('replyDraft', text);
  },
  sendReply(event) {
    event.preventDefault();
    const text = this.data.get('replyDraft').trim();
    const id = this.data.get('selectedId');
    if (!text || id === null) return;
    const message = {
      id: Date.now(),
      author: this.data.get('internalNote') ? '内部备注' : '客服',
      text,
      internal: this.data.get('internalNote')
    };
    this.data.set('tickets', this.data.get('tickets').map(ticket => ticket.id === id ? Object.assign({}, ticket, { messages: ticket.messages.concat(message), status: this.data.get('internalNote') ? ticket.status : 'pending' }) : ticket));
    this.data.set('replyDraft', '');
    this.emitEvent('reply', { ticketId: id, message });
  },
  changeStatus(status) {
    const id = this.data.get('selectedId');
    this.data.set('tickets', this.data.get('tickets').map(ticket => ticket.id === id ? Object.assign({}, ticket, { status }) : ticket));
    this.emitEvent('status', { ticketId: id, status });
  },
  assignAgent(event) {
    const assignee = event.target.value;
    const id = this.data.get('selectedId');
    this.data.set('tickets', this.data.get('tickets').map(ticket => ticket.id === id ? Object.assign({}, ticket, { assignee }) : ticket));
    this.emitEvent('assign', { ticketId: id, assignee });
  },
  setMergeTarget(event) {
    this.data.set('mergeTargetId', Number(event.target.value) || null);
  },
  mergeTicket() {
    const sourceId = this.data.get('selectedId');
    const targetId = this.data.get('mergeTargetId');
    if (!targetId) return;
    const source = this.data.get('tickets').find(ticket => ticket.id === sourceId);
    this.data.set('tickets', this.data.get('tickets').map(ticket => ticket.id === targetId ? Object.assign({}, ticket, { messages: ticket.messages.concat(source.messages) }) : ticket).filter(ticket => ticket.id !== sourceId));
    this.data.set('selectedId', targetId);
    this.emitEvent('merge', { sourceId, targetId });
  },
  priorityRank(priority) {
    return { urgent: 0, high: 1, normal: 2 }[priority] || 3;
  },
  priorityText(priority) {
    return { urgent: '紧急', high: '高', normal: '普通' }[priority];
  },
  statusText(status) {
    return { open: '处理中', pending: '等待客户', closed: '已关闭' }[status];
  }
});
</script>

修复目标：输出必须满足下面列出的 San 结构、语法和渲染一致性规则；不要只生成语义上看起来像 San 的代码。

输出要求：
1. 只输出完整 .san 文件内容，不要输出解释、标题或 Markdown 代码围栏。
2. 必须包含 <template>、<script>、<style> 三段。
3. <script> 中必须使用 const san = require('san')、const DataTypes = san.DataTypes、module.exports = san.defineComponent(...)。
4. Vue props 必须迁移为 San dataTypes，禁止在 san.defineComponent 中输出 props: {...}。
5. initData() 只能返回稳定默认数据对象；Vue props 的 default（包括数组/对象工厂默认值）必须作为同名字段落入 initData；Vue data() 的全部初始值必须精确等价地保留，包括嵌套对象、数组、数字和启用项集合，不得用空字符串、空数组或删减后的集合替代；如果内部 data 依赖 props，必须在 inited() 中用 this.data.get('propName') 读取并 this.data.set(...) 同步。
6. 组件状态读写必须使用 this.data.get('field') 和 this.data.set('field', value)；San computed 的结果也在 data store 中，computed 之间的依赖以及普通方法读取 computed 时必须使用 this.data.get('computedName')，禁止 this.computed.foo()；Vue 的 this.$emit(...) 或 emitEvent 包装方法必须迁移为 this.fire(...)，禁止 this.props、this.xxx 状态读写、this.$emit 和用 this.dispatch(...) 代替自定义事件。
7. 方法必须直接定义在 san.defineComponent 顶层，禁止保留 Vue 的 methods: {...} 包裹。
8. template 必须使用 San 语法：on-click、s-if、s-for；保留事件调用的全部参数，例如 on-click="move(-1)"、on-click="select(task.id)"；Vue v-for 的 :key 必须写入 s-for 的 trackby 子句，例如 s-for="task in tasks trackby task.id"，禁止输出独立 key="{{ task.id }}" 或 key="{= task.id =}"；所有 {{ ... }} 和 {= ... =} 插值必须完整闭合；双向绑定 {= assignable.path =} 只能用于可赋值的数据路径，方法调用、computed 表达式和其他派生值必须使用单向插值；disabled、checked、selected 等派生属性必须使用 disabled="{{ expression }}" 这一类单向插值，禁止写成 disabled="{= expression =}"；方法调用、computed 表达式和其他派生值必须使用单向插值，例如 checked="{{ isEnabled(rule.id, enabled) }}"；禁止丢失参数、使用 data-args/getAttribute 绕行，或保留 @click、v-if、v-for、v-model、:class 等 Vue 模板语法。
9. style 标签必须写成 <style>，禁止输出 <style scoped>；必须保留原有 class 名和样式内容。
10. 不要重新设计组件，不要引入外部依赖，不要删除已有 DOM 节点、文本、class 或样式。
11. 如果 DOM 对比报告指出缺失/新增/变化节点，优先修复 template 结构。
12. 补充要求：优先修复 validate 与 visual_eval 报告中指出的问题，保持原有 DOM 结构、文本、class 和样式。

- 是否存在 props:、methods:、this.props、this.$emit、this.dispatch、<style scoped>、@click、v-if、v-for、v-model、:class？如果存在，必须改掉。
- SSM props 是否全部出现在 dataTypes 中？
- 带 default 的 Vue props 是否以同名字段和等价默认值出现在 initData 中？
- Vue data() 中每个初始值是否精确保留了原始类型、嵌套内容、数组元素和数值，而不是空值或删减值？
- computed 之间以及普通方法中是否只通过 this.data.get('computedName') 读取 computed，且完全不存在 this.computed.foo()？
- 所有 {= ... =} 是否都是可赋值数据路径；disabled、checked、selected 等派生属性是否使用 {{ ... }} 单向插值；方法调用和 computed 等派生表达式是否使用 {{ ... }} 单向插值？
- 所有 {{ ... }} 和 {= ... =} 是否完整闭合；Vue v-for 的 :key 是否迁移为 s-for 内联 trackby，且不存在独立 key 属性？

<template>
<section class="support-ticket-console">
  <header>
    <div>
      <p class="muted">{{openCount}} 个处理中</p>
      <h2>{{inboxTitle}}</h2>
    </div>
    <div class="actions">
      <input placeholder="搜索" value="{{query}}" on-input="updateQuery" />
      <select value="{{statusFilter}}" on-change="updateStatusFilter">
        <option value="all">全部状态</option>
        <option value="open">处理中</option>
        <option value="pending">等待客户</option>
        <option value="closed">已关闭</option>
      </select>
    </div>
  </header>
  <div class="tag-strip">
    <button s-for="tag in allTags trackby tag" class="{{tag === selectedTag ? 'active' : ''}}" on-click="filterTag(tag)">{{tag}}</button>
  </div>
  <div class="ticket-layout">
    <aside class="ticket-list">
      <button s-for="ticket in visibleTickets trackby ticket.id" class="{{selectedId === ticket.id ? 'selected' : ''}} {{ticket.priority === 'urgent' ? 'urgent' : ''}}" on-click="selectTicket(ticket.id)">
        <span>
          <strong>#{{ticket.id}} {{ticket.subject}}</strong>
          <small>{{ticket.customer}} · {{statusText(ticket.status)}}</small>
        </span>
        <i>{{priorityText(ticket.priority)}}</i>
      </button>
      <p class="empty" s-if="{{!visibleTickets.length}}">无匹配工单</p>
    </aside>
    <main s-if="{{selectedTicket}}">
      <div class="conversation-head">
        <div>
          <h3>{{selectedTicket.subject}}</h3>
          <span>{{selectedTicket.customer}}</span>
        </div>
        <span class="sla {{slaState}}">SLA {{selectedTicket.age + nowTick}} 分钟</span>
      </div>
      <div class="messages">
        <article s-for="message in selectedTicket.messages trackby message.id" class="{{message.internal ? 'internal' : ''}}">
          <strong>{{message.author}}</strong>
          <p>{{message.text}}</p>
        </article>
      </div>
      <form class="reply-box" on-submit="sendReply">
        <div>
          <button s-for="text in cannedReplies trackby text" on-click="useCanned(text)">{{text}}</button>
        </div>
        <textarea value="{{replyDraft}}" on-input="updateReply"></textarea>
        <footer>
          <label>
            内部备注
            <input type="checkbox" checked="{{internalNote}}" on-change="toggleInternal" />
          </label>
          <button class="primary" type="submit" disabled="{{!replyDraft}}">发送</button>
        </footer>
      </form>
    </main>
    <aside class="ticket-properties" s-if="{{selectedTicket}}">
      <h3>工单属性</h3>
      <label>
        负责人
        <select value="{{selectedTicket.assignee}}" on-change="assignAgent">
          <option value="">未分配</option>
          <option s-for="agent in agents trackby agent" value="{{agent}}">{{agent}}</option>
        </select>
      </label>
      <div>
        <b s-for="tag in selectedTicket.tags trackby tag">{{tag}}</b>
      </div>
      <div>
        <button on-click="changeStatus('open')">处理中</button>
        <button on-click="changeStatus('pending')">等待</button>
        <button on-click="changeStatus('closed')">关闭</button>
      </div>
      <label>
        合并到
        <select value="{{mergeTargetId || ''}}" on-change="setMergeTarget">
          <option value="">选择工单</option>
          <option s-for="ticket in mergeCandidates trackby ticket.id" value="{{ticket.id}}">#{{ticket.id}}</option>
        </select>
      </label>
      <button on-click="mergeTicket" disabled="{{!mergeTargetId}}">执行合并</button>
    </aside>
  </div>
</section>
</template>

<script>
const san = require('san');
const DataTypes = san.DataTypes;

module.exports = san.defineComponent({
  name: 'SupportTicketConsole',
  dataTypes: {
    inboxTitle: DataTypes.string,
    agents: DataTypes.array,
    initialTickets: DataTypes.array,
    cannedReplies: DataTypes.array
  },
  initData() {
    return {
      tickets: [],
      selectedId: null,
      query: '',
      statusFilter: 'all',
      replyDraft: '',
      internalNote: false,
      selectedTag: '',
      mergeTargetId: null,
      nowTick: 0,
      timer: null
    };
  },
  computed: {
    visibleTickets() {
      const q = this.data.get('query').toLowerCase();
      const rank = { urgent: 0, high: 1, normal: 2 };
      return this.data.get('tickets').filter(ticket => (this.data.get('statusFilter') === 'all' || ticket.status === this.data.get('statusFilter')) && (!this.data.get('selectedTag') || ticket.tags.indexOf(this.data.get('selectedTag')) >= 0) && (ticket.subject.toLowerCase().indexOf(q) >= 0 || ticket.customer.toLowerCase().indexOf(q) >= 0)).slice().sort((a, b) => (rank[a.priority] || 3) - (rank[b.priority] || 3));
    },
    selectedTicket() {
      return this.data.get('tickets').find(ticket => ticket.id === this.data.get('selectedId')) || null;
    },
    openCount() {
      return this.data.get('tickets').filter(ticket => ticket.status === 'open').length;
    },
    slaState() {
      const ticket = this.data.get('selectedTicket');
      if (!ticket) return 'none';
      const age = ticket.age + this.data.get('nowTick');
      return age >= 60 ? 'breached' : age >= 45 ? 'warning' : 'safe';
    },
    allTags() {
      return Array.from(new Set(this.data.get('tickets').reduce((all, ticket) => all.concat(ticket.tags), [])));
    },
    mergeCandidates() {
      return this.data.get('tickets').filter(ticket => ticket.id !== this.data.get('selectedId') && ticket.status !== 'closed');
    }
  },
  inited() {
    const initialTickets = this.data.get('initialTickets') || [];
    const tickets = initialTickets.map(ticket => Object.assign({}, ticket, { tags: ticket.tags.slice(), messages: ticket.messages.map(message => Object.assign({}, message)) }));
    this.data.set('tickets', tickets);
    this.data.set('selectedId', initialTickets[0] ? initialTickets[0].id : null);
  },
  attached() {
    this._timer = setInterval(() => {
      this.data.set('nowTick', this.data.get('nowTick') + 1);
    }, 60000);
  },
  disposed() {
    if (this._timer) {
      clearInterval(this._timer);
      this._timer = null;
    }
  },
  setValue(key, value) {
    this.data.set(key, value);
  },
  emitEvent(name, payload) {
    this.fire(name, payload);
  },
  updateQuery(event) {
    this.data.set('query', event.target.value);
  },
  updateStatusFilter(event) {
    this.data.set('statusFilter', event.target.value);
  },
  filterTag(tag) {
    this.data.set('selectedTag', this.data.get('selectedTag') === tag ? '' : tag);
  },
  selectTicket(id) {
    this.data.set('selectedId', id);
    this.data.set('replyDraft', '');
    this.data.set('mergeTargetId', null);
  },
  updateReply(event) {
    this.data.set('replyDraft', event.target.value);
  },
  toggleInternal(event) {
    this.data.set('internalNote', event.target.checked);
  },
  useCanned(text) {
    this.data.set('replyDraft', text);
  },
  sendReply(event) {
    event.preventDefault();
    const text = this.data.get('replyDraft').trim();
    const id = this.data.get('selectedId');
    if (!text || id === null) return;
    const message = {
      id: Date.now(),
      author: this.data.get('internalNote') ? '内部备注' : '客服',
      text,
      internal: this.data.get('internalNote')
    };
    this.data.set('tickets', this.data.get('tickets').map(ticket => ticket.id === id ? Object.assign({}, ticket, { messages: ticket.messages.concat(message), status: this.data.get('internalNote') ? ticket.status : 'pending' }) : ticket));
    this.data.set('replyDraft', '');
    this.emitEvent('reply', { ticketId: id, message });
  },
  changeStatus(status) {
    const id = this.data.get('selectedId');
    this.data.set('tickets', this.data.get('tickets').map(ticket => ticket.id === id ? Object.assign({}, ticket, { status }) : ticket));
    this.emitEvent('status', { ticketId: id, status });
  },
  assignAgent(event) {
    const assignee = event.target.value;
    const id = this.data.get('selectedId');
    this.data.set('tickets', this.data.get('tickets').map(ticket => ticket.id === id ? Object.assign({}, ticket, { assignee }) : ticket));
    this.emitEvent('assign', { ticketId: id, assignee });
  },
  setMergeTarget(event) {
    this.data.set('mergeTargetId', Number(event.target.value) || null);
  },
  mergeTicket() {
    const sourceId = this.data.get('selectedId');
    const targetId = this.data.get('mergeTargetId');
    if (!targetId) return;
    const source = this.data.get('tickets').find(ticket => ticket.id === sourceId);
    this.data.set('tickets', this.data.get('tickets').map(ticket => ticket.id === targetId ? Object.assign({}, ticket, { messages: ticket.messages.concat(source.messages) }) : ticket).filter(ticket => ticket.id !== sourceId));
    this.data.set('selectedId', targetId);
    this.emitEvent('merge', { sourceId, targetId });
  },
  priorityRank(priority) {
    return { urgent: 0, high: 1, normal: 2 }[priority] || 3;
  },
  priorityText(priority) {
    return { urgent: '紧急', high: '高', normal: '普通' }[priority];
  },
  statusText(status) {
    return { open: '处理中', pending: '等待客户', closed: '已关闭' }[status];
  }
});
</script>

san_generation_contract.description: 约束大模型基于本 schema 生成 San 组件时必须满足的条件。
must_preserve: metadata.component_name 和根节点语义
template.dom_tree 的层级结构、节点顺序与语义角色
template.component_refs 中每个子组件的注册名和父子通信事件
binding_graph 中 data/props/computed 到模板节点的可见绑定
event_model 中每个 DOM 事件和自定义事件的触发时机与 payload
style_model 中动态类名、动态样式、scoped CSS 和关键视觉状态
script.options.lifecycle_hooks 中的副作用初始化与清理逻辑
script.options.data 中所有字段的默认值和外部初始化来源
quality_checks: template.component_refs 中每个子组件都在 script.components 或 san_registration 中有定义
binding_graph.edges 中每条 template 依赖都能在 script.options 中找到来源
event_model.dom_events 中每个 handler_name 都存在于 script.options.methods
event_model.custom_events 中每个 emit_points 都对应 method 中的 $emit 调用
style_model.dynamic_class_bindings 的 dependencies 都存在于 binding_graph.nodes
script.options.watch 中的 deep watcher 在 migration_hints 中被标记并给出替代策略
san_syntax_requirements: 输出完整的 .san 单文件组件，包含 <template>、<script>、<style> 三个代码块；若无样式也保留空 style 或显式说明无样式
脚本块显式引入 san：const san = require('san')，并使用 module.exports = san.defineComponent(...) 导出组件
props 使用 san.DataTypes 声明，与 script.options.props 一一对应；优先输出 DataTypes.number / string / bool / array / object
组件定义使用 san.defineComponent
组件名来自 metadata.component_name，并显式输出 name 字段
data 使用 initData 返回默认值，与 script.options.data 一一对应；不要在 initData 中直接依赖复杂运行时读取
当 data 字段来源于 props 或外部初始化时，优先在 inited/attached 中用 this.data.set 完成同步
模板中使用 s-if、s-for、on-event、value={= =}、checked={= =} 等 San 语法
状态访问统一使用 this.data.get() / this.data.set()
优先将 methods 直接定义在组件对象顶层，避免保留 Vue 风格的 methods: {} 包裹
子组件标签使用短横线命名
子组件在 components 中显式注册
样式块需尽量完整输出，优先复用 styles/style_model 中已有 class 与 css_rules 信息
定时器、timeout、外部监听等副作用在 attached/disposed 中管理
